acceptance: Positive incremental exact-program gain in each saved run, with no decrease in any declared preservation metric in any of the twelve families. Original invalid and exact attempts remain unchanged; depth-specific outcomes are descriptive.
alternative: Source connection context may be insufficient when generated interiors or reaction-core states are incorrect; correspondence ambiguity and edge-count constraints can still prevent recovery.
hypothesis: Joint generated-interior reuse and registry-qualified program connection completion resolves some edge-count obstructions while preserving all frozen validity, exactness, diversity and novelty criteria.
inference_limit: Previously inspected saved TRAIN layouts/noise with extra source-derived program context and bounded gate-guided computation. Not independent holdout, learned improvement, new-layout autonomy, or full IL qualification.
stopping_rule: One proposal per qualified occurrence, all attempts/proposals/abstentions retained. No post-result parameter changes or gate relaxation; preserve negative outcomes.
